decisions.reason: The source assigns beige specifically to the K markings on green dispense buttons; it does not change the existing green accents, beige body, or support-base colors.
The K marking color is independent of the support-base logo and lettering color.
Changing the K marking color does not alter button-actuated dispensing behavior, flow control, or the dispensing mechanism.
The source concerns lettering on dispense buttons, not the machine placard's text, placement, or orientation.
The source does not change the master power control's type or location.
The beige K marking changes button decoration only; the placement of speed, dispense, and power controls remains unchanged.
Dispense-button marking color has no effect on bowl capacity, depth, geometry, or event-use priorities.
The marking color does not change the enclosure's dimensions or form factor.
The source does not alter spout geometry, orientation, material, mounting, or appearance.
The beige K marking does not affect whether the dispensing path or spouts are removable or cleanable.
The source does not change the raised platform's configuration, dimensions, footprint, or cup-clearance purpose.
Selecting beige for the K markings does not necessarily alter any current BOM component selection or deliverable state.
